name: scott-claude-plugins
description: Personal plugins for Claude. Each plugin's description states which surface it needs: Cowork, Claude Code, or both.

plugins.name: gitify-cowork-project
plugins.description: Cowork only. Puts an existing Cowork Project folder under git without touching its documents: commit helpers, and a CLAUDE.md holding the Project Instructions and how Claude commits and reads the history.

plugins.name: prose-tuning
plugins.description: Claude Code and Cowork. Learns a project's house prose style from edits already made, records it as prose-style.md with stable rule ids, and conforms the rest of the documents to it.

plugins.name: todos
plugins.description: Claude Code only. Files the TODO comments left in a project's uncommitted changes as GitHub issues, or hands one to an installed skill made for its work, after the author approves every draft, and marks each one in its file with where it went.
